transcript: It's no secret that Claude sucks at design, but if you want your designs to go from this to that, these are the three skills that you need right now. The first one is taste. This one is literally the anti-slop front-end skill for AI agents, and it can even connect with ChatGPT's image tool model to create images that fit well with what you're creating. Crazy. Then you have design motion principles by Kyle Zen which combines the philosophies of three of the best UI/UX designers out there into one motion on it. It will tell you what's wrong with your current design and fix it for you. And last but not least is impeccable. It's a skill that teaches Claude deep design knowledge and gives you 18 commands, yes 18, to steer the result when you don't necessarily have the right words to fix the way that it look. If you want a free guide on how to use all three skills, just comment guide and I'll send it to you. Otherwise, make sure to follow for more videos like this.
